result.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?
result.markdown:
For a small online store, my top recommendation is **Stripe**, unless you're already using Shopify—in that case, I'd choose **Shopify Payments**\.

The best option depends on your website platform, where your customers are located, and how much you're selling.

## Best payment processors for small businesses

![Vagus Nerve Certification | MindMax Academy](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/aXMVm1C0IZ2sYL1Cc-pnLa0-TAY84r1ttAkC3L-BonUW-0ZWt4YgfYxZJFNFO507YDw7sEw0_m36oWUAFe9k5k5U7mabcFJnFcYfX_JEQIwvZxSSTzYlrpiE9fNs0cFfLq2VqBOGktLoGahF64GIPKHvKbJJ1Jz0L_56eTNx-TPu4D5oHHq8-DAX5xxs05i8?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Stripe**

(Best overall)

- Easy to integrate with most online stores.
- Accepts major credit and debit cards.
- Supports recurring payments and international sales.
- No standard monthly processing fee.
- Good reporting and fraud prevention.
  
  Best for WooCommerce, custom websites and independent online stores.
  
  [Stripe website](https://stripe.com/)

---

![Shopify Payments w Polsce – jak działa, koszty, wdrożenie, zalety - Adtrip](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/tzlxg0Y9z5dRoMa7puRQ5gUF-G3hcQ7FEcuVco38BEG917LKXepufVl9cw-FwTKDdqoHqkcHNs202c43Bsg-KXxlvnrYPNEJMBSIYJqLREQ2DlgIvAOQgkKyUCOU_zdRd59gIwC2e-5cs0YCLvv_6mYa-9FiK4qFkvvkawoheALPlNv3AkWQkvUMElw-UVk8?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Shopify Payments**

(Best for Shopify stores)

- Built directly into Shopify.
- Simple checkout experience.
- No additional third-party transaction fee when using Shopify Payments.
- Easy order and refund management.
  
  [Shopify Payments website](https://www.shopify.com/ca/payments)

---

![Download the PayPal logo in PNG y SVG | LogosDown](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/MAzkiJ1YuDnyj2FyYAyszlEHA_k7S0XqFuDRhbVDc0cICTj1-X82VJgt7N8vcRcKsONlo3HvF0Pe2MUizAJnEXGjXwhkQKSdT9w8dASkeKU2hONBc_K0UGh46cKL9ey1QEsmTJtnMOjwtp9k8flMfotUdye-2o09Vcb_X37Fr_RqbfMx2vNQ-Z2QRLli3zQI?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. PayPal**

- Recognized and trusted by many shoppers.
- Customers can pay using PayPal or eligible cards.
- Easy to add as another checkout option.
- Can be more expensive depending on transaction type.
  
  [PayPal Business website](https://www.paypal.com/ca/business)

---

![square-logo](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/1usVU99QTc623Z1qK0LnerrVUCFuaCZRY9kzKFoWI_Gdr9NcpX1vWKOmILymiErxn6ndDcZZ0Or5-PjPVYj_lTK1K9NB9Q8Cck3TogeQjE13w7S0OC_soTbxUb84o9oqvCcpbffi8RgWQf3ncfxvUqtopiXbgd9lTiIMfcExXBRU8XgKgcPu-V2QhGDsZYzn?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Square**

- Great if you sell online and in person.
- Inventory and sales management.
- Simple payment processing.
- Particularly useful for small retailers.
  
  [Square Canada website](https://squareup.com/ca/en)

## My recommendation

If I were starting a small online store, I'd generally choose\:

- **Shopify store\:** Shopify Payments + PayPal.
- **WooCommerce store\:** Stripe + PayPal.
- **Custom-built website\:** Stripe.
- **Online and physical retail\:** Square.

One important consideration: payment processing rates differ by country, currency, and transaction type. Make sure you compare Canadian pricing if your business is based in Canada.

## A few questions so I can narrow it down

I'd like to recommend the processor that will cost you the least while still being easy to use.

**1\. What platform is your online store using?**

---

**3\. Approximately how much do you expect to process monthly?**

---

**4\. Where will most of your customers be?**

With those answers, I can compare actual processing costs and help you avoid paying unnecessary transaction fees.
